lines.text: Eight years ago I was starting college [[in a dark place]]......
And it was about to [[get worse]] before it got better...
I woke up [[sick with anxiety]] every single morning...
I couldn't even say my own name in front of a class...
so I'd smoke a joint every morning just to [[ease my nerves]]...
[[I didn't know who I was]], or who I was meant to be...
Me and my twin Jack have been side by side since we were five...
growing up, we were the men of the house...
whatever happened, we had each other's back...
A year into college, I found a podcast by __Andrew Huberman__...
he talked about the brain like something you could actually train...
not something you were [[stuck with]]...
for the first time, I stopped being the anxiety and started watching it...
I went down a rabbit hole of books on the mind...
psychology, the subconscious, how beliefs are built...
I knew the theory inside out...
But at 24, [[I froze at a networking event]]...
the same feeling as that classroom, years later...
all that knowledge, and I [[still couldn't get out of my own way]]...
Then I met my mentor...
he used hypnosis on me
and two weeks later, I walked into the next event calm...
From then on, it was mind first. Then the body...
every single morning, before anything else...
I rebuilt who I was, one day at a time...
The first person I helped was my mum...
it wasn't me telling her. It was me showing her...
Now I help founders who've done everything right, and [[still feel stuck]]...
I find what's been holding them back, and I remove it...
they step into the best version of themselves...
and finally hit the goals they've been chasing for years...
And this year, I hosted my own seminar...
a full room of people ready to change...
calm on the stage, where I once couldn't say my own name...
Now we're on a mission to give millions of people more life

Not more money. Not more stuff.
More life.
Comment LIMITLESS and I'll show you where to start
